rules.paraphrase: A correct and complete invoice carries the contract number, parties, invoice number and date, billing period and, for each task, date, time, timekeeper, position and rate.
A filing charge names the document filed and the entity and location it was filed with.
Each expense is supported by a copy of the receipt or other proof of payment.
Billing rates must be the same as those set in the outside counsel contract.
An expense that requires agency pre-approval must have been pre-approved.
An invoice summary shows total hours per timekeeper, subtotals and the total of all invoices to date.

params.scope: services within the term and scope of the contract

rules.paraphrase: Billed services must lie within the term and scope of the outside counsel contract.

unmapped_provisions.paraphrase: Invoice plus prior payments may not exceed the maximum liability in the contract.
Invoice approval by the agency's chief administrator and the Attorney General.
Outside counsel pays a non-refundable administrative fee to the Attorney General.
